title.zh: OpenAI与谷歌达成分销协议，前沿模型及Codex登陆谷歌云
title.en: OpenAI and Google Cloud reach distribution deal for frontier models and Codex

current_state.zh: OpenAI and Google Cloud are bringing OpenAI frontier models and Codex workflows into Gemini's Model Garden, purchasable through Google Cloud Marketplace.
current_state.en: OpenAI and Google Cloud are bringing OpenAI frontier models and Codex workflows into Gemini's Model Garden, purchasable through Google Cloud Marketplace.

updates.title_zh: OpenAI与谷歌达成AI分销协议，前沿模型及Codex将登陆谷歌云
updates.title_en: OpenAI与谷歌达成AI分销协议，前沿模型及Codex将登陆谷歌云
updates.what_changed_zh: OpenAI struck an AI distribution deal with Google to offer frontier models including GPT-6 Astra and Codex through Google Cloud Marketplace, with enterprise purchases counting toward existing cloud spending commitments, extending its multi-cloud push after the Microsoft exclusivity arrangement ended and its AWS expansion.
